basic_info.description: Top-flr 2br + office home at The District, a modern bldg at the nexus of Lower Pac Heights, Laurel Heights & the Divisadero Corridor. Enjoy soaring ceilings, hardwood wood floors, west-facing light, central A/C, high speed internet and many more smart home upgrades. Chef's kit features Euro cabs, Caesarstone counters, stylish backsplash, Bosch appls & a 36 built-in Thermador fridge. Bonus office/den is perfect for WFH or pantry. Spacious LR/DR flows to 2 BRs, incl. a king-sized primary suite w/ 2 closets & luxe ensuite bathdual vanities, soaking tub & glass shower. Guest bath also offers a soaking tub & floating vanity. In-unit Bosch W/D. Whole-home CAT6 wiring + multiple internet options. Bldg amenities: attended lobby, pkg, fitness center, clubroom, dog wash, bike storage, compost/recycle chutes, & rooftop sky deck w/ BBQs, firepit, WiFi & city views. HOA covers water, gas, garbage, sewer & bldg maintenance. Steps to Alta Plaza Park & Divisadero/Fillmore shops, cafes & more!
